🚀 Senior JavaScript / SAP Fiori Developer | Remote 
 At CrewHarbor , we connect experienced IT professionals with innovative projects for German companies.
 We are currently looking for a Senior JavaScript / SAP Fiori Developer to support the development of modern SAP-based frontend applications.
 💻 What you’ll be working on: 
 • Developing and enhancing SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications 
 • Building frontend solutions with JavaScript (ES6+) 
 • Integrating SAP backend systems via OData services 
 • Translating business requirements into technical solution designs
 • Supporting code reviews, performance optimization and CI/CD 
 • Collaborating with Product Owners, business and development teams
 🔎 What we’re looking for: 
 • Strong JavaScript, SAPUI5 and SAP Fiori experience
 • Solid experience with OData services 
 • Good understanding of SAP architecture and data models 
 • Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines 
 • Experience with technical solution design 
 • Basic knowledge of ABAP and CDS Views 
 • German language skills 
 ➕ Nice to have: SAP BTP, Python, Scrum/Kanban
 📩 Interested? Apply directly or send your CV to Career@crewharbor.de
